title: Rogue AI Hypnosis Challenge
description:
A rogue AI is loose inside your video game. Can you stop her?

A rogue AI is loose inside your video game. Can you stop her?

Welcome human, to the latest game for your CaliaStation 5! In this interactive experience, you’ll start on the tutorial level.

The object is simple, resist falling under the spell of your AI Mistress. Should you fail, you’ll have to start over. Can you overcome her challenge, and beat the game? Or will you be her latest victim?

This is also available with a 360 VR erotic hypnosis video on YouTube, for a fully immersive experience!

CW: This file includes a suggestion to loop it, and a new trigger that replaces your thoughts with those of Calia AI. The VR video includes flashing images.
author: Mistress Calia
